title: Federation reference publication can mask a retired authority fence with a path-inspection error
outcome: A reference publish whose captured authority has been retired reports the stale-link conflict even when pre-open state-path inspection also fails, while current-authority publications still fail closed on path errors.
acceptance: A deterministic regression retires the captured publication authority while publication is paused and confirms the request returns the stale-link conflict without publishing, even if the pre-open path inspection fails.
A current publication authority with a state-path inspection error remains fail-closed, reports the unresolved I/O failure, and publishes no reference.
The publication authority is still revalidated at the final commit fence; early classification does not permit stale publication or bypass path-redirection checks.
disposal_reason: Created while investigating the earlier H1/H2 hypothesis before Fable2's superseding #1778 classification. The observed gate failure is classified environment/resource; no separate product item is warranted from that run. Cancel to remove the speculative unassigned issue.
